title: Prep Prep Prep (Remix)
style: Funk rock track at 120 BPM in E major. The arrangement features a clean electric guitar playing syncopated 16th-note scratches and staccato riffs, a distorted lead guitar performing blues-based pentatonic fills, and a slap bass line that locks with a punchy drum kit. The drums utilize a crisp snare and active hi-hat patterns. Male vocals are delivered with a rhythmic, soulful grit, occasionally shifting into a falsetto range. Brass stabs from a trumpet and saxophone section punctuate the transitions. The track concludes with a prominent distorted guitar solo featuring rapid alternate picking and wide vibrato.
lyrics:
[Intro]
[clean electric guitar scratches, slap bass enters]
[distorted lead guitar blues lick]
[drum fill, brass stabs]

[Verse 1]
[male vocals with grit]
It's all in the preparation [brass hits]
[driving drum beat, syncopated guitar riff]
Preparation will set you free
Turn seconds into today
Free your brain for your gain
Turn seconds into today

[Chorus]
[brass section melody]
All the time in the world
You got it girl
[falsetto] Oh!
Turn seconds into today
It'll change your game

[Bridge]
[distorted guitar solo with wah-wah effect]
[brass stabs]

[Outro]
[rapid alternate picking guitar solo]
[final brass hit]
